## Step 1 — Confirm escalated perspectives

Escalated perspectives for deep review:
- **Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity** (HIGH)
- **Cognitive & Neurodivergent** (MEDIUM)

Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed): Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Auditory Access, Keyboard & Motor Access, Screen Reader & Semantic Structure.

---

## Step 4 & 5 — Per-Perspective Checklists & Findings

### Perspective 3: Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity (HIGH)

**Finding:** All animations (icon bounce, slide transitions, progress fill, background gradient) lack `prefers-reduced-motion` media query support. Users with vestibular disorders cannot suppress motion.
**WCAG:** 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide), 2.3.1 (Three Flashes) / Motion Policy
**Perspective:** Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity
**Severity:** CRITICAL
**Route to:** UX Design (primary: motion policy decisions) (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** CSS contains `@keyframes iconBounce`, `transition` on `.step-slider`, `.progress-fill`, and `.onboarding`. No `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` present. Fires auto-CRITICAL red flag.
**Fix:** Wrap all animation/keyframe/transition rules in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { ... }` to suppress them when the user prefers reduced motion.

**Finding:** Confetti canvas animation runs for 3 seconds with no visible pause or stop control once triggered.
**WCAG:** 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide)
**Perspective:** Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** UX Design (primary: animation policy) (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** `setTimeout(() => setShowConfetti(false), 3000);` in JS. No pause/stop button rendered alongside the canvas or action bar.
**Fix:** Render a visible "Pause" or "Stop" button near the confetti area or in the action bar that sets `showConfetti` to false and immediately calls `cancelAnimationFrame(raf)`.

---

### Perspective 7: Cognitive & Neurodivergent (MEDIUM)

**Finding:** Personal data input fields (`name`, `role`) lack `autocomplete` attributes, forcing manual entry and increasing cognitive load for users with memory or motor impairments.
**WCAG:** 1.3.5 (Identify Input Purpose)
**Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Content Author + UX Design (primary: input purpose definition) (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** `<input id="name" type="text" />` and `<input id="role" type="text" />` in JSX. No `autocomplete` props present.
**Fix:** Add `autocomplete="name"` to the name input and `autocomplete="job-title"` (or appropriate value) to the role input.

**Finding:** Focus remains on the trigger button after step transitions; new step content is not announced or brought into focus, forcing users to re-navigate via Tab each time.
**WCAG:** 3.2.1 (On Focus), 2.4.3 (Focus Order)
**Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Content Author + UX Design (primary: interaction pattern design) (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** `goNext` and `goBack` only update React state. No `ref` or `focus()` call on the new `.step-panel` or its first interactive element. DOM order remains static while CSS transforms hide/show panels.
**Fix:** After state updates, programmatically move focus to the first interactive element or heading of the newly visible step panel using a `useEffect` hook tied to `step`. Add `aria-live="polite"` to the step container to announce content changes.

**Finding:** No validation logic or error feedback mechanism is implemented for the form fields. Users receive no guidance if inputs are invalid or required, increasing cognitive friction.
**WCAG:** 3.3.1 (Error Identification), 3.3.3 (Error Suggestion)
**Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Content Author + UX Design (primary: error messaging patterns) (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** Component renders inputs but contains no `onChange` validation, `required` attributes, or error state rendering logic.
**Fix:** Implement client-side validation on blur/submit. Associate error messages via `aria-describedby` and visually indicate invalid states with non-color cues (e.g., icon + text). Ensure error suggestions provide specific corrective actions.

---
